name: Computational Techniques for Solid State Materials
description: Schrodinger equation, solution of simple model calculations namely, 1D mono-atomic lattice, nearly free electron model, concept of band structure, tight binding method, the Born-Oppenheimer approximation, mean field theory and solution of hydrogen-like systems, Pauli exclusion principle and anti-symmetry, wave-function based methods, Hartree theory, Hartree-Fock theory, exchange interaction, Koopman’s theorem, density functional theory (DFT), Kohn-Sham equations, Hohenberg-Kohn theorems, exchange correlation functional, self-interaction, hybrid functional, pressure and temperature molecular dynamics (MD), concept of thermostat.
